Action.description:
Push method. Optional. Default is `PUSH_IMMEDIATELY`.

><notice>

The batch push API `CreateMassPushTask` supports only the following push methods:

- `PUSH_IMMEDIATELY`

- `SCHEDULED_PUSH`

></notice>

Target.description: Target for the message. Optional when the operation type `Action` is `CREATE_CONTINUOUS_PUSH`.

Type.description:
Target type.

><notice>

The batch push API `CreateMassPushTask` and continuous push `CONTINUOUS_PUSH` support only these target types:

- `DEVICE`

- `ACCOUNT`

- `ALIAS`

></notice>

Value.description:
Target value, based on `Target.Type`. Separate multiple targets with commas. Target types and values:

> - `DEVICE`: Device ID, such as deviceid1,deviceid2. Maximum 1000 IDs.
>
> - `ACCOUNT`: Account ID, such as account1,account2. Maximum 1000 IDs.
>
> - `ALIAS`: Alias, such as alias1,alias2. Maximum 1000 aliases.
>
> - `TAG`: One or more tags. See the [tag format specification](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434847.html).
>
> - `ALL`: Send to all devices. Do not set a value. This may increase costs. Use with caution.

Message.title: 消息内容
Message.description:
Pass-through message data sent to devices. Total length must not exceed 4000 bytes.

> Length calculation
>
> - Length is the UTF-8 byte count of the JSON-serialized Message object.
>
> - Each Chinese character uses 3 bytes in UTF-8.

Notification.description:
Vendor notification data sent to devices.

><notice>

When both `Message` and `Notification` are set, only one is delivered. The rule is:

- If the device is online, send the pass-through message.

- If the device is offline, send the system notification.

></notice>

Title.description:
Notification title.

> Length limits:
>
> - iOS/Harmony: maximum 200 **bytes**
>
> - Android: maximum 50 **characters**

Body.description:
Notification body.

> Length limit:
>
> - iOS/Harmony/Android: maximum 200 **characters**
Body.example: 尊敬的客户，您好！您的预约订单已取消成功。

Music.description:
iOS notification sound. Specify the audio file name stored in the app bundle or the sandbox Library/Sounds directory. See [How to set notification sounds for iOS push](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48906.html).

> - An empty string (””) mutes the notification.
>
> - If not set, defaults to the system alert sound.

BadgeAutoIncrement.description:
Enable auto-increment for the badge number. Optional. Default is false.

> - Do not use with the Badge parameter.
>
> - Alibaba Cloud maintains the badge count per device. Requires SDK version 1.9.5 or later. The SDK must sync the badge number to the server.

Silent.description:
Enable silent push mode.

> - For silent notifications, omit the `title` and `body` parameters.

Mutable.description:
Enable extended notifications. Controls whether iOS notifications support Notification Service Extension processing.

> - Must be true for silent notifications.
>
> - Extension processing time must not exceed 30 seconds.
>
> - If it times out, the notification shows raw content.
>
> - Add a Notification Service Extension to your app.

Category.description:
iOS notification category identifier. Defines interaction behavior and display style.

> - Categories must be registered in the app to take effect.
>
> - Different categories can define different action sets.

CollapseId.description: Unique identifier for notification grouping. Notifications with the same identifier replace each other.

ThreadId.description:
iOS notification thread identifier. Groups related notifications for collapsed display.

> - Notifications with the same thread-id group automatically.
>
> - Multiple related notifications collapse into one group.
>
> - Users can expand to see all notifications in the group.

InterruptionLevel.description:
Interruption level. Optional. Valid values:

- `passive`: Add to notification list without lighting the screen or playing sound.

- `active`: Display immediately, light the screen, and play sound.

- `time-sensitive`: Display immediately, light the screen, and play sound, but respect system notification controls.

- `critical`: Display immediately, light the screen, and play sound even if the mute switch is on.

RelevanceScore.description: Notification relevance score. Controls priority and display strategy.

ExtParameters.description:
iOS notification custom extension properties.

> - Must be a valid JSON Map. Invalid format causes parsing failure.

LiveActivity.description:
Live Activities parameter object.

><notice>

- Live Activities support only single-device push by `DEVICE` type.

- For Live Activities, omit the title and body parameters.

></notice>

Id.description:
Unique identifier for the Live Activity. Links the device-side activity instance to the server-side push target.

><notice>

- This `ID` must match the `forActivityId` parameter in the client SDK's `registerLiveActivityPushToken` method.

- The server uses this `ID` to locate the specific activity instance.

></notice>

Event.description: Start, update, or end a Live Activity.

AttributesType.description:
Type of Live Activity to start.

> Required when `Event` is start.

Attributes.description:
Static pass-through parameters for iOS Live Activities. Passes unchanging business identifiers.

> Required when `Event` is start.

ContentState.description:
Dynamic pass-through parameters for Live Activities. Contains real-time status and changing data.

> - Avoid frequent updates (suggest interval ≥5 seconds).
>
> - Batch update multiple fields to reduce push frequency.
>
> - Avoid UI flicker for better user experience.
>
> - Must be a valid JSON string.

DismissalDate.description: Retention time for ended Live Activities on the lock screen. Lets users view info after the activity ends. Unix timestamp in seconds.

StaleDate.description:
Expiration timestamp for Live Activity content. Unix timestamp in seconds.

> - After this time, the system marks the activity as expired.
>
> - Expired activities disappear from the Dynamic Island and lock screen.
>
> - Prevents outdated info from occupying the UI.

ApnsEnv.description:
iOS notifications use APNs. Set the environment. Optional. Default is production.

- DEV: Development environment. For apps installed directly via Xcode.

- PRODUCT: Production environment. For apps distributed via App Store, TestFlight, Ad Hoc, or enterprise channels.

Category.description:
Notification category. Optional. Default is `MARKETING`.

> After applying for self-classification rights, this identifies the message type. Different types affect display and alert behavior. See the HarmonyOS official site [Notification.category](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section17371529101117).

SlotType.description:
Use a specified notification channel type.

> - Valid only for Alibaba Cloud's own channel.
>
> - See the HarmonyOS official site [SlotType](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/js-apis-notificationmanager-V5#slottype).

NotifyId.description: Unique identifier for the message in the notification bar. If omitted, the push service generates one. Use the same notifyId for different messages to replace old ones with new ones. See the HarmonyOS official site [Notification.notifyId](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section17371529101117).

Action.description:
Action for the app's ability page.

> See the HarmonyOS official site [ClickAction.action](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section152462191216).

Uri.description:
URI for the app's ability page.

> - When multiple abilities exist, specify the action and URI for each. Action takes precedence when locating the page.
>
> - See the HarmonyOS official site [ClickAction.uri](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section152462191216).

RenderStyle.description: Notification style. Optional. Default is normal.

ImageUrl.description:
URL for the large icon on the right side of the notification. Must use HTTPS.

> - Supported formats: png, jpg, jpeg, heif, gif, bmp. Image dimensions must be less than 25000 pixels.
>
> - See the HarmonyOS official site [Notification.image](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section17371529101117).

InboxContent.description: Required when `RenderStyle` is `MULTI_LINE`. Defines multi-line text content. Supports up to 3 lines.

ExtParameters.description:
Custom extension properties for notifications. Pass extra business data.

> Must be a valid JSON Map. Invalid format causes parsing failure.

TestMessage.description:
Enable test messages.

> - See the HarmonyOS push parameters [TestMessage](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section418321011212).

ReceiptId.description:
HarmonyOS channel receipt ID. View this ID in the receipt parameter settings of the HarmonyOS channel push operations platform.

> - If the default receipt setting in the HarmonyOS channel push operations platform is Alibaba Cloud receipt, you do not need to provide this. Otherwise, configure the default receipt ID for the HarmonyOS channel in the Alibaba Cloud EMAS Mobile Push console.
>
> - See the HarmonyOS official site [pushOptions.receiptId](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section418321011212).

ExtensionPush.description:
Enable HarmonyOS notification extension.

> - You must apply for permission on the HarmonyOS official site before sending extension messages. See the [HarmonyOS documentation](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-guides-V5/push-send-extend-noti-V5) for sending extension messages.
>
> - Supported starting with HarmonyOS SDK version 1.2.0.

ExtensionExtraData.description:
Extra data for notification extension messages.

> - Valid only for HarmonyOS notification extension messages.
>
> - Equivalent to the extraData field in HarmonyOS notification extension messages. See the HarmonyOS [ExtensionPayload](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section161192514234) specification.
>
> - Supported starting with HarmonyOS SDK version 1.2.0.

BadgeSetNum.description:
HarmonyOS app badge number.

> - See the HarmonyOS badge [setNum field](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section266310382145).
>
> - Supported starting with HarmonyOS SDK version 1.2.0.

BadgeAddNum.description:
HarmonyOS app badge increment.

> - Supported starting with HarmonyOS SDK version 1.2.0.
>
> - See the HarmonyOS badge [addNum field](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section266310382145).

LiveViewPayload.description: JSON string for the HarmonyOS Live View payload structure [LiveViewPayload](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V13/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V13#section66881469306). For development, see the [HarmonyOS Live View Push Guide](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2982112.html).

Sound.title: 鸿蒙自定义铃声文件名

SoundDuration.title: 自定义消息通知铃声时长，单位秒，范围 [1,60]，铃声时长不足时将会循环播放
SoundDuration.description: Custom notification ringtone duration in seconds. Range: \[1, 60]. Shorter ringtones loop.

VendorChannelActivity.description:
Activity to launch when the user taps the notification.

><warning>

Required when using Android vendor channels.

></warning>

ChannelId.description:
Android app channel ID. Must match the channel ID in the vendor app.

> - For OPPO private messaging channels, the channel\_id matches the app's channelId. So use this value for OPPO pushes.
>
> - For Huawei, FCM, and Alibaba Cloud's own channel, use this value.
>
> - See the FAQ: [Android 8.0+ devices do not receive notifications](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67398.html).

RenderStyle.description:
Notification style. Valid values:

- `0`: Standard mode (default)

- `1`: Long-text mode (supports Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO, Meizu, and Alibaba Cloud's own channel)

- `2`: Large-image mode (supports Alibaba Cloud's own channel)

- `3`: Inbox mode (supports Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO, and Alibaba Cloud's own channel)

PictureUrl.description: Image URL for large-image mode. Supported for Alibaba Cloud's own channel with Android SDK 3.6.0 or later.

ImageUrl.description:
Large icon URL. Supported for:

- `Huawei EMUI` (only for long-text and inbox modes).

- `Honor Magic UI` (only for long-text mode).

- `Alibaba Cloud's own channel` (Android SDK 3.5.0 or later).

InboxContent.description:
Content for inbox mode. Must be a valid JSON array with no more than 5 elements. Supported for:

- Huawei: EMUI 9 or later

- Honor: Magic UI 4.0 or later

- Xiaomi: MIUI 10 or later

- OPPO: ColorOS 5.0 or later

- Alibaba Cloud's own channel: Android SDK 3.6.0 or later

NotifyId.description:
Unique identifier for Android notification bar messages. Controls replacement behavior. New notifications with the same NotifyId replace old ones.

> Supported for Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO, Vivo, and Meizu vendor channels (except FCM).

GroupId.description:
Message grouping. In the notification bar, only the latest message and total count for the group appear. Users cannot expand to see all messages. Supported for:

- Huawei

- Honor

- Alibaba Cloud's own channel

ExtParameters.description:
Android notification custom extension properties.

> - Must be a valid JSON Map. Invalid format causes parsing failure.

Music.description: Huawei vendor channel notification sound. Specify the audio file name in the client project's `app/src/main/res/raw/` directory. Do not include the file extension. If not set, uses the default ringtone.

BadgeSetNum.description:
Set a fixed badge number. Range: \[1–99].

> - Works only for Huawei and Honor vendor channels.
>
> - For Alibaba Cloud's own channel, works only on Huawei, Honor, and vivo devices.

BadgeAddNum.description:
Add to the current badge number.

> - Supported for Huawei and Honor vendor channels.
>
> - If both BadgeAddNum and `BadgeSetNum` are set, `BadgeSetNum` takes precedence.

BadgeActivity.description:
Full class name of the app's entry activity for badge settings.

> Valid only for Huawei and Honor vendor channels.

TestMessage.description:
Set vendor channel notification type:

- `false`: Production notification (default).

- `true`: Test notification.

> Currently supported for Huawei, Honor, vivo, and OPPO Fluid Cloud channels.

Accs.description:
Alibaba Cloud's own channel configuration

> Valid only for Alibaba Cloud's own channel.

CustomStyle.description:
Android custom notification bar style. Value range: 1–100.

> Requires client-side style presets. See the [Custom Notification Style Interface](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834944.html).

Priority.description: Notification priority in the notification bar. Valid values: -2, -1, 0, 1, 2.

ThreadId.description:
Message grouping. Messages in the same group collapse in the notification bar. Users can expand them. Messages in different groups show separately.

> Android SDK 3.9.2 or later.

OpenType.description:
Action when the user taps the notification. Valid values:

- `APPLICATION`: Open the app (default)

- `ACTIVITY`: Open a specific activity (`OpenActivity`)

- `URL`: Open a URL

- `NONE`: No action

OpenActivity.description: Activity to open when the user taps the notification. Valid only when `OpenType` is `ACTIVITY`.

OpenUrl.description: URL to open when the user taps the notification. Valid only when `OpenType` is `URL`.

NotifyType.description:
Notification alert method. Valid values:

- `VIBRATE`: Vibrate (default)

- `SOUND`: Sound

- `BOTH`: Sound and vibration

- `NONE`: Silent

ReceiptId.description:
Huawei channel receipt ID. View this ID in the receipt parameter settings of the Huawei channel push operations platform.

> If the default receipt setting in the Huawei channel push operations platform is Alibaba Cloud receipt, you do not need to provide this. Otherwise, configure the default receipt ID for the Huawei channel in the Alibaba Cloud EMAS Mobile Push console.

Category.description:
First purpose: After applying for [self-classification rights](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835?#section3410731125514), identify the message type to determine [alert behavior](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000001149358835__p3850133955718), accelerate delivery for specific types, and follow the [message classification standard](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#section1076611477914). Use the "cloud notification category value" or "local notification category value" from the table in the documentation.

Second purpose: After applying for [special permissions](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/faq-0000001050042183#section037425218509), identify high-priority pass-through scenarios. Valid values:

- `VOIP`: Voice and video calls

- `PLAY_VOICE`: Voice announcements

> * If the "cloud notification category value" is "not applicable", use Alibaba Cloud's own channel.
>
> * If the "local notification category value" is "not applicable", use the Huawei channel.

Urgency.description:
Huawei channel pass-through message delivery priority. Valid values:

- `HIGH`

- `NORMAL`

Requires permission application. See the [application link](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/faq-0000001050042183#section037425218509).

Importance.description:
Set the Huawei notification importance parameter. Determines device notification behavior. Valid values:

- `0`: Information and marketing messages

- `1`: Service and communication messages

> We recommend using `Category` for notification classification. Apply on the Huawei platform at [application link](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#section893184112272).

BusinessType.description:
Set Huawei quick notification parameter

- **0**: Send Huawei regular notification (default).

- **1**: Send Huawei quick notification.

LiveNotificationPayload.description: JSON string for the Huawei Android Live Notification payload structure [LiveNotificationPayload](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/HMSCore-References/rest-live-0000001562939968#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000001700850537__p195121620102511). For development, see the [Huawei Live Notification Push Guide](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2983768.html).

Importance.description:
Set the Honor notification importance parameter. Determines device notification behavior. Valid values:

- `0`: Information and marketing messages

- `1`: Service and communication messages

Apply on the Honor platform at [application link](https://developer.honor.com/cn/docs/11002/guides/notification-class#%E8%87%AA%E5%88%86%E7%B1%BB%E6%9D%83%E7%9B%8A%E7%94%B3%E8%AF%B7).

Channel.description:
Set the Xiaomi notification channel ID. Apply on the Xiaomi platform. See the [application link](https://dev.mi.com/console/doc/detail?pId=2422#_4).

> Xiaomi allows up to 8 channels per app. Plan ahead.

Category.description:
vivo classifies messages into two categories: system messages and operational messages.

**System messages:**

- IM: Instant messages

- ACCOUNT: Account and assets

- TODO: Calendar and tasks

- DEVICE\_REMINDER: Device information

- ORDER: Orders and logistics

- SUBSCRIPTION: Subscription alerts

**Operational messages:**

- NEWS: News

- CONTENT: Content recommendations

- MARKETING: Operational activities

- SOCIAL: Social updates

See the [vivo classification guide](https://dev.vivo.com.cn/documentCenter/doc/359#s-ef3qugc3).

ReceiptId.description:
vivo vendor push channel receipt identifier. Used to receive push result callbacks.

> - Location: vivo Open Platform → Push Service → App Info → Receipt Settings
>
> - Recommendation: Configure the default receipt ID in the Alibaba Cloud EMAS console.
>
> - Condition: Required only when the vivo platform default receipt is not Alibaba Cloud receipt.

Importance.description:
Set the vivo notification message category. Valid values:

- `0`: Operational messages (default)

- `1`: System messages

> We recommend using `Category` for notification classification. Apply on the vivo platform at [application link](https://dev.vivo.com.cn/documentCenter/doc/359).

Category.description:
OPPO classifies messages into two categories: communication and services, and content and marketing.

**Communication and services (requires permission):**

- IM: Instant messages

- ACCOUNT: Account and assets

- TODO: Calendar and tasks

- DEVICE\_REMINDER: Device information

- ORDER: Orders and logistics

- SUBSCRIPTION: Subscription alerts

**Content and marketing:**

- NEWS: News

- CONTENT: Content recommendations

- MARKETING: Operational activities

- SOCIAL: Social updates

See the [vivo classification guide](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=13189).

NotifyLevel.description:
OPPO channel notification alert level. Valid values:

- `1`: Notification bar

- `2`: Notification bar, lock screen, sound, vibration (default for communication and service messages)

- `16`: Notification bar, lock screen, sound, vibration, banner (requires permission)

> When using `NotifyLevel`, you must also provide the `Category` parameter.

PrivateContentParameters.description: OPPO private message template content parameters

IntelligentIntent.description: JSON string for the OPPO Fluid Cloud intelligent intent data structure [IntelligentIntent](https://open.oppomobile.com/documentation/page/info?id=13565). For development, see the [OPPO Fluid Cloud Push Guide](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2997310.html).

DeleteIntentData.description: JSON string for the OPPO Fluid Cloud intent deletion data structure [data](https://open.oppomobile.com/documentation/page/info?id=13578). Invalid when AndroidOppoIntelligentIntent is set. For development, see the [OPPO Fluid Cloud Push Guide](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2997310.html).

NoticeMsgType.description:
Meizu message type

- 0: Public messages (default)

- 1: Private messages

UseChannels.description:
Specify delivery channels. Valid values:

- `accs`: Alibaba Cloud's own channel

- `huawei`: Huawei channel

- `honor`: Honor channel

- `xiaomi`: Xiaomi channel

- `oppo`: OPPO channel

- `vivo`: vivo channel

- `meizu`: Meizu channel

- `gcm`: Google GCM channel (legacy HTTP)

- `fcm`: Google Firebase channel (HTTP v1 API)

- `apns`: APNs channel

- `harmony`: HarmonyOS channel

> * If not set, all channels are available.
>
> * If set, only the listed channels are used.
>
> * If the listed channels conflict with the send policy (e.g., iOS notifications require APNs but apns is not in the list), no send occurs.
>
> * If gcm is set, both GCM and FCM channels are used. If fcm is set, only FCM is used.

PushTime.description:
Send time for the message. Must be within 7 days. Valid only when `Action` is `SCHEDULED_PUSH`.

> Uses ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

ExpireTime.description:
Message expiration time. Messages expire and are not sent after this time. Maximum retention is 72 hours.

> - Uses ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
>
> - ExpireTime must be greater than PushTime + 3 seconds (3 seconds accounts for network and system latency).
>
> - Recommendations: At least 1 minute for single pushes. At least 10 minutes for full or batch pushes.

><notice>

For pass-through messages, omitting ExpireTime means send only to online devices. Offline devices discard the message.

></notice>

JobKey.description: Custom identifier for the push task. When JobKey is not empty, it appears in the receipt log. See [receipt logs](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434651.html).

Trim.description:
Automatically truncate long titles or bodies.

> Only applies to vendor channels that explicitly limit title or body length. Not applicable to APNs, Huawei, or Honor channels, which limit only the total request body size.

Sms.description:
Fallback SMS.

> Currently supports only `Android` and `HarmonyOS` devices.

TemplateName.description: SMS template name. Get it from the SMS template management interface. This is the system-assigned name, not the developer-defined name.

Params.description: Key-value pairs for SMS template variables.

DelaySecs.description:
Delay before sending the SMS, in seconds.

Required for SMS fallback. Recommend at least 15 seconds. Maximum is 3 days to avoid duplicate SMS and push.

> When using SMS fallback, the ExpireTime parameter is ignored. The notification expiration time is calculated as current time plus DelaySecs.

BindTag.summary: Binds a tag to a target, such as a device, account, or alias. The binding takes effect within 10 minutes.

schema.description: Your AppKey.
The device ID, account, or alias. Separate multiple values with commas. You can specify up to 1000 values.

The type of the ClientKey. Valid values:

- **DEVICE**: A device

- **ACCOUNT**: An account

- **ALIAS**: An alias

The tag to bind. Separate multiple tags with commas. You can bind up to 10 tags in one call. Each tag name must be no longer than 128 characters (a Chinese character counts as one character). Each app supports up to 10,000 tags. A single device can have multiple tags.

><notice>

Avoid binding the same tag to more than 100,000 devices. Doing so increases processing time and slows down responses. For large-scale pushes, use one of these methods:

- Use the broadcast push feature to send messages to all devices at once.

- Split your device group across multiple fine-grained tags and call the push API in batches.

></notice>

> - Duplicate tag bindings are automatically removed.
>
> - When a user uninstalls your app, the associated tags are automatically detached. This may take a short time.

ContinuouslyPush.title: ContinuouslyPush
ContinuouslyPush.description:
This API addresses the limitations of the [Push Advanced Push API](~~2249916~~), where push-by-device, push-by-account, and push-by-alias operations each have a maximum target count per single call.

- You can use continuous push when your scenario requires sending the same message to many devices. In this case, you can call the continuous push API repeatedly, each time specifying a group of targets for aggregation (the current limit is 1,000 targets per call for device, account, or alias pushes). The total number of pushes for the same MessageId is restricted to 10,000. If you need a higher limit, contact technical support to evaluate your specific scenario.

- Before using this API, you must first call the Push API with Target set to TBD (To Be Determined) and include your message content. This returns a MessageId from the push system. You can then use this MessageId to repeatedly call the continuous push API, specifying different target groups to deliver the same message.

- After calling the Push API with Target set to TBD and obtaining a MessageId, the message is stored in the push system for 24 hours by default. You can use this API to push to specified targets at any time before expiration. Pushes are not allowed after expiration or after reaching the total push limit.

- Each call to this API sends the message immediately. Scheduled pushes are not supported.

StoreOffline.description:
Whether to store offline messages or notifications. StoreOffline defaults to false.

If enabled, when a user is offline during push delivery, the message will be resent when the user comes online within the expiration time (ExpireTime). The default ExpireTime is 72 hours. iOS notifications use APNs and are unaffected by StoreOffline.

SendChannels.description:
Specify the delivery channels. Valid values:

- accs: Alibaba Cloud proprietary channel

- huawei: Huawei channel

- honor: Honor channel

- xiaomi: Xiaomi channel

- oppo: OPPO channel

- vivo: vivo channel

- meizu: Meizu channel

- gcm: Google GCM channel (legacy HTTP)

- fcm: Google Firebase channel (HTTP v1 API)

- apns: APNs channel

- harmony: HarmonyOS channel

> * If you don't set this parameter, all available channels can be used.
>
> * If you set this parameter, only the specified channels will be used.
>
> * If the configured channels conflict with the delivery policy (for example, iOS notifications must use APNs, but apns isn't included in this parameter), the message won't be sent.
>
> * If you set gcm, the system can use either Google GCM or FCM channels. If you set fcm, only the Google FCM channel will be used.

PushTime.description:
Schedule the push delivery time. If not set, the message is sent immediately.

Use ISO8601 format in UTC: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

ExpireTime.description:
The expiration time for offline messages or notifications. Works with StoreOffline. Messages expire after this time and won't be delivered. Maximum retention is 72 hours. Default is 72 hours.

Use ISO8601 format in UTC: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. ExpireTime must be greater than the current time or PushTime plus 3 seconds (`ExpireTime > PushTime+3 seconds`). The 3-second buffer accounts for network and system delays. For individual pushes, set at least 1 minute. For broadcast or batch pushes, set at least 10 minutes.

JobKey.description: A custom identifier for the push task. If JobKey is not empty, it appears in the receipt logs. For details about receipt logs, see [Receipt Logs](~~434651~~).

Title.description:

- iOS 10+: displays the title.

- iOS 8.2 ≤ iOS version < iOS 10: replaces the app name in the notification.

Body.description: The content of the notification or message for Android and HarmonyOS. For iOS, this is the message or notification content. Content size limits apply. For details, see [Product Limits](~~92832~~).

Trim.description: Note: This feature applies only to vendor channels that enforce specific length limits on titles and content. It does not apply to channels such as APNs, Huawei, and Honor, which limit the total size of the request body rather than the length of individual titles or content.

iOSApnsEnv.description:
iOS notifications are sent through APNs. Specify the environment:

- DEV: development environment, for apps installed and debugged directly via Xcode.

- PRODUCT: production environment, for apps distributed via the App Store, TestFlight, Ad Hoc, or enterprise channels.

iOSRemind.description:
If the device is offline (no persistent connection to the Mobile Push server) when sending a message, deliver it as a notification through Apple's APNs channel once.

> Offline message-to-notification conversion works only in the production environment.

iOSRemindBody.description: The iOS notification body used when converting a message to a notification. Valid only when iOSApnsEnv=PRODUCT and iOSRemind=true.

iOSMusic.description:
The iOS notification sound. Specify the audio filename stored in the app bundle or the sandbox Library/Sounds directory. For details, see "How to Set Notification Sounds for iOS Push."

If set to an empty string ("") the notification is silent. If not set, it defaults to "default" (system sound).

iOSBadge.description:
The badge number on the iOS app icon.

> If iOSBadgeAutoIncrement is true, this field must be empty.

iOSBadgeAutoIncrement.description:
Enable automatic badge increment. Default is false.

The push server maintains a badge count per device. Requires SDK version 1.9.5 or later and explicit badge synchronization from the client to the server.

iOSMutableContent.description: iOS notification service extension flag (iOS 10+). If true, APNs delivers the notification to the Extension for processing before displaying it. Must be true for silent notifications.

iOSNotificationCollapseId.description: Messages with the same CollapseId are merged into one notification. If the device is offline and receives multiple messages with the same CollapseId, only one appears in the notification center. Supported on iOS 10+.

iOSNotificationThreadId.description: Groups iOS remote notifications. Identifies the collapsed group. Supported on iOS 12.0+.

iOSInterruptionLevel.description:
The interruption level. Valid values:

- passive: adds the notification to the list without lighting the screen or playing a sound.

- active: displays the notification immediately, lights the screen, and can play a sound.

- time-sensitive: displays the notification immediately, lights the screen, and can play a sound, but respects system notification controls.

- critical: displays the notification immediately, lights the screen, and plays a sound even if the device is in silent mode.

iOSRelevanceScore.description: The relevance score for highlighting in the summary. Value range: floating-point number between 0 and 1.

For iOS 10+, specify the rich push notification resource URL here: `{"attachment": "https://xxxx.xxx/notification_pic.png"}`. Pass this parameter as a JSON map. Otherwise, parsing fails.

AndroidMessageOppoCategory.description:

- IM: instant messaging, audio, and video calls

- ACCOUNT: personal account and asset changes

- DEVICE\_REMINDER: personal device reminders

- ORDER: personal order/logistics status changes

- TODO: personal schedules/to-dos

- SUBSCRIPTION: personal subscriptions

Content & Marketing:

- NEWS: news

- CONTENT: content recommendations

- MARKETING: platform activities

- SOCIAL: social updates

For details, see [OPUSH Message Classification Rules](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=13189).

AndroidMessageVivoCategory.description:
vivo classifies messages into two categories: System Messages and Operational Messages.

System Messages:

- IM: instant messages

- ACCOUNT: account and assets

- TODO: schedules and to-dos

- DEVICE\_REMINDER: device information

- ORDER: orders and logistics

- SUBSCRIPTION: subscription alerts

Operational Messages:

- NEWS: news

- CONTENT: content recommendations

- MARKETING: operational activities

MassPush.title: Batch Push
MassPush.description:
**Before using this API, make sure you fully understand the [pricing and billing model](~~434638~~) of EMAS Mobile Push.**

In some business scenarios, you may need to send unique messages to many devices within a short period. If the number of devices and messages is large, this can generate a high number of queries per second (QPS), which can exceed the QPS limit for a single source IP and cause some push requests to fail.

This API addresses this issue. It supports up to 100 independent push tasks in a single call. By aggregating requests, it effectively reduces QPS and improves the stability and success rate of large-scale, individualized pushes. The per-account rate limit for MassPush is 500 calls per second.

Each independent push task supports only three types of targets: device, account, or alias. SMS integration is not supported.

> Upgrade your SDK to version 3.11.0 or later.

## PushTask properties

- The format for PushTask properties is PushTask.N.Property. These properties include the following:

  - Destination

  - Configuration

  - iOS notification settings

  - Android notification settings

  - Android auxiliary popup window settings

  - HarmonyOS notification settings

  - Push control

- Each PushTask represents an independent push task. You can include up to 100 tasks. The configuration options are identical to those in the standard Push API.

- The PushTask.N.Target parameter supports only DEVICE, ACCOUNT, and ALIAS.

- PushTask does not support SMS integration.

- The product of the number of parent and child nodes must not exceed 10,000. If this limit is exceeded, the parameters are considered invalid.

Push type. Valid values:

- **NOTICE**: Notification. Notifications use vendor channels such as APNs, Huawei, Xiaomi, and HarmonyOS to deliver to devices and appear in the notification tray. When an Android device is online (app process is active), Alibaba Cloud uses its own channel first to build and display the notification. This improves performance and saves vendor message quotas in some cases.

- **MESSAGE**: Message. Messages use Alibaba Cloud's online channel. They do not appear in the notification tray by default. Instead, the app must receive and handle them while active. The app decides whether to trigger business logic. If the device is offline (app process inactive), messages are not delivered immediately. To handle this, set `iOSRemind` or `AndroidRemind` to convert messages to notifications when offline. Or set `StoreOffline` to save messages until the device comes back online.

- **ACCOUNT**: Push to specific accounts.

- **ALIAS**: Push to specific aliases.

- **TAG**: Push to specific tags.

- **ALL**: Push to all devices of the specified DeviceType. Wait at least one second between full pushes.

> For iOS full pushes, notifications go to devices that were active in the last 24 months and have not uninstalled your app. APNs marks a push as delivered once it receives the request without error. This can cause a spike in active device counts and unexpected costs. Use with caution.

## Request parameter details

**Title and body details:**

| Attribute\Push Type | Message (iOS)                                                                           | Message (Android)                        | Notification (iOS)   | Notification (Android)                                                           |
| :------------------ | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------- | :------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Title               | Message title, corresponds to the title field in CCPSysMessage in the message callback. | CPushMessage.title field                 | Notification title   | Notification title, in the notification callback method (onNotificationOpened)   |

**The following configurations apply only to the Android auxiliary pop-up feature:**

If a device is offline—meaning it has no persistent connection to Mobile Push servers—the auxiliary pop-up feature can be triggered during a push. To enable this feature, see [Mobile Push Auxiliary Channel Configuration](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30067.html). The following conditions must also be met:

- You have integrated a third-party auxiliary channel.

- You have set StoreOffline to true.

- You are pushing a notification (no need to set AndroidRemind) or pushing a message and have set AndroidRemind to true.

- You have correctly configured the AndroidPopupActivity, AndroidPopupTitle, and AndroidPopupBody parameters.
Push.extraInfo:
# Java Sample Code

```
PushRequest pushRequest = new PushRequest();
// Push Target
pushRequest.setAppKey(appKey);
pushRequest.setTarget("ALL"); // Push target: DEVICE: push to device; ACCOUNT: push to specified account; TAG: push to custom tag; ALIAS: push by alias; ALL: broadcast push
pushRequest.setTargetValue("all"); // Set this value according to the Target. For example, if Target=DEVICE, the value should be device ID1, device ID2, etc. Separate multiple values with commas. (There is a limit of up to 100 accounts or devices per request.)
pushRequest.setDeviceType("iOS"); // Device type: "iOS" for iOS devices; "ANDROID" for Android devices; "ALL" for all devices (this is the default value).
// Push Configuration
pushRequest.setPushType("MESSAGE"); // MESSAGE: message (default); NOTICE: notification
pushRequest.setTitle("Hello"); // Title of the message
pushRequest.setBody("PushRequest body"); // Content of the message
// Push Configuration: iOS
pushRequest.setIOSBadge(5); // Badge number on the iOS app icon
pushRequest.setIOSMusic("default"); // Notification sound for iOS
pushRequest.setIOSApnsEnv("PRODUCT"); // iOS notifications are sent via APNs. Specify the environment: 'DEV' for development environment; 'PRODUCT' for production environment
pushRequest.setIOSRemind(true); // If the device is offline (i.e., the persistent connection channel between the device and Alibaba Cloud Mobile Push server is disconnected) when the message is pushed, the message will be delivered once as a notification through Apple's APNs. Note: **Converting offline messages to notifications applies only to the `production environment`**
pushRequest.setIOSRemindBody("PushRequest summary"); // Content used for the iOS notification when an offline message is converted to a notification. This parameter takes effect only when IOSApnsEnv=`PRODUCT` and IOSRemind=true
pushRequest.setIOSExtParameters("{"k1":"ios","k2":"v2"}"); // Extended properties of the notification (Note: This parameter must be passed in JSON map format; otherwise, parsing will fail)
// Push Configuration: Android
pushRequest.setAndroidOpenType("ACTIVITY"); // Action after clicking the notification: 'APPLICATION': open the application; 'ACTIVITY': open a specific Android Activity; 'URL': open a URL; 'NONE': no action
pushRequest.setAndroidNotifyType("SOUND"); // Notification alert method: 'VIBRATE': vibrate; 'SOUND': sound; 'DEFAULT': sound and vibration; 'NONE': no handling (customized by the user)
pushRequest.setAndroidOpenUrl("http://www.alibaba.com");
pushRequest.setAndroidMusic("alicloud_notification_sound"); // Notification sound for Huawei OEM channel
pushRequest.setAndroidActivity("com.alibaba.push.PushActivity"); // The Android Activity to open upon receiving the push. Effective only when `AndroidOpenType="ACTIVITY"`
pushRequest.setAndroidPopupActivity("com.alibaba.push.PopupActivity"); // Enable auxiliary pop-up window feature by setting this parameter. Specifies the Activity to jump to after clicking the notification (Prerequisites for auxiliary pop-up: 1. Integrate third-party auxiliary channels; 2. Set StoreOffline parameter to true)
pushRequest.setAndroidPopupTitle("Popup Title"); // Title of the auxiliary pop-up notification
pushRequest.setAndroidPopupBody("Popup Body"); // Content of the auxiliary pop-up notification
pushRequest.setAndroidNotificationBarType(50); // Custom Android notification bar style, value range: 1–100
pushRequest.setAndroidNotificationBarPriority(2); // Priority of the Android notification in the notification bar, valid values: -2, -1, 0, 1, 2
pushRequest.setAndroidExtParameters("{"k1":"android","k2":"v2"}"); // Extended properties of the notification (Note: This parameter must be passed in JSON map format; otherwise, parsing will fail)
// Push Control
final Date pushDate = new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + 3600 * 1000); // Used for scheduled sending. If not set, the message is sent immediately by default. The time must follow the ISO8601 standard and use UTC time in the format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.
final String pushTime = ParameterHelper.getISO8601Time(pushDate);
pushRequest.setPushTime(pushTime); // Delayed push. Optional; if not set, the message is pushed immediately
pushRequest.setStoreOffline(true); // Whether to store offline messages. If enabled, users who are offline at the time of push will receive the message the next time they come online. On Android, if set to false, only Alibaba Cloud’s own online channel is used.
final String expireTime = ParameterHelper.getISO8601Time(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + 12 * 3600 * 1000)); // Message expires after 12 hours and will no longer be sent
pushRequest.setExpireTime(expireTime);
pushRequest.setSendChannels("accs,huawei,honor,vivo,xiaomi,oppo"); // Specify the push channels to use. If not specified, the system selects any available channel
pushRequest.setAndroidNotificationNotifyId(1234567); // Set the notification overwrite parameter to prevent duplicate notifications from appearing in scenarios such as retries
pushRequest.setAndroidTargetUserType(0); // Indicates that if this push is delivered via Huawei, Honor, or vivo channels, it is a formal notification. However, in this sample code, this value is overridden by OEM-specific parameters
pushRequest.setAndroidHuaweiTargetUserType(1); // Indicates that if this push is delivered via the Huawei channel, it is a test notification
pushRequest.setAndroidHonorTargetUserType(1); // Indicates that if this push is delivered via the Honor channel, it is a test notification
pushRequest.setAndroidVivoPushMode(1); // Indicates that if this push is delivered via the vivo channel, it is a test notification. Before pushing, ensure the vivo device's regId is added to the test device list in the vivo push platform
pushRequest.setAndroidHuaweiReceiptId("ABCDEFG"); // Huawei OEM channel receipt ID
// OEM Channel Notification Categorization
pushRequest.setAndroidNotificationChannel("user_define"); // OPPO private message channel channel_id and general Android channel_id
pushRequest.setAndroidNotificationXiaomiChannel("user_define"); // Xiaomi channel notification type channel_id
pushRequest.setAndroidNotificationHonorChannel("NORMAL"); // Honor channel message categorization parameter, corresponding to the importance parameter in the Honor channel
pushRequest.setAndroidMessageHuaweiCategory("ACCOUNT"); // Huawei channel notification categorization parameter. Service and communication notifications require permission approval from the Huawei channel
pushRequest.setAndroidMessageVivoCategory("ACCOUNT"); // vivo channel notification categorization parameter. System messages require permission approval from the vivo channel
// SMS Fused Notification
pushRequest.setSmsTemplateName("SMS_1234567"); // Set SMS template name
pushRequest.setSmsSignName("Testing"); // Set SMS signature
pushRequest.setSmsParams("name=Bob&code=123"); // SMS template variables
pushRequest.setSmsSendPolicy(0); // SMS fallback policy: 0 means send SMS if the device does not receive the push notification
pushRequest.setSmsDelaySecs(120); // Trigger SMS after 2 minutes if the push is not received
PushResponse pushResponse = client.getAcsResponse(pushRequest);
System.out.printf("RequestId: %s, MessageId: %s
",
        pushResponse.getRequestId(), pushResponse.getMessageId());
```
